# Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu Complete Examination Blueprint & All-Subject Practice Guide

## 1. Official Conducting Authority & Entry Architecture
- **Conducting Body**: Central Airmen Selection Board (CASB), Indian Air Force (IAF), Ministry of Defence.
- **Official Web Portal**: agnipathvayu.cdac.in
- **Recruitment Scheme**: Agnipath Scheme for Agniveer Vayu (Intake 01/2026 & 02/2026).
- **Exam Mode**: Online Computer Based Test (CBT Phase-I) followed by PFT, Adaptability Tests, and Medical Examination.

## 2. Multi-Stream Examination Schemes & Marking Norms
1. **Science Subjects (Technical / Group X)**:
   - Total Questions: 70 Questions (English: 20, Mathematics: 25, Physics: 25)
   - Total Marks: 70 Marks | Duration: 60 Minutes
   - Marking Scheme: **+1.0 Mark** per correct answer, **-0.25 Marks (1/4th penalty)** per incorrect answer.
2. **Other Than Science Subjects (Non-Technical / Group Y)**:
   - Total Questions: 50 Questions (English: 20, RAGA: 30)
   - Total Marks: 50 Marks | Duration: 45 Minutes
   - Marking Scheme: **+1.0 Mark** per correct answer, **-0.25 Marks (1/4th penalty)** per incorrect answer.
3. **Science and Other Than Science Subjects (Both Groups)**:
   - Total Questions: 100 Questions (English: 20, Mathematics: 25, Physics: 25, RAGA: 30)
   - Total Marks: 100 Marks | Duration: 85 Minutes
   - Marking Scheme: **+1.0 Mark** per correct answer, **-0.25 Marks (1/4th penalty)** per incorrect answer.

## 3. Multi-Subject Sampling (50% Representative Coverage)
- **English Language**: 150 Questions
- **Physics (10+2)**: 150 Questions
- **Mathematics (10+2)**: 150 Questions
- **RAGA - Reasoning**: 150 Questions
- **RAGA - General Awareness**: 150 Questions
- **Total Sampled Practice Questions**: 750 Questions

# IAF Agniveer Vayu Reasoning and General Awareness (RAGA) High-Yield Blueprint

## 1. Strategic Role of RAGA
- RAGA carries **30 Marks (60% weightage)** in the Other Than Science stream and **30 Marks (30% weightage)** in the Both Streams examination.
- High score in RAGA ensures candidate clears the overall aggregate cut-off for merit ranking.

## 2. High-Yield Practice Excerpts

**Q1 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0001]**
- (EN): Find the next term in the number series: 7, 14, 28, 56, 112, ____? (Reasoning Problem #1)
- (HI): दी गई संख्या श्रृंखला में अगला पद ज्ञात कीजिए: 7, 14, 28, 56, 112, ____? (तर्कशक्ति प्रश्न #1)
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q2 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0002]**
- (EN): In a certain code language, 'RADAR' is coded as 'TBECT'. How will 'PILOT' be coded in that same language? (Reasoning Problem #2)
- (HI): एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में 'RADAR' को 'TBECT' लिखा जाता है। उसी भाषा में 'PILOT' को कैसे लिखा जाएगा? (तर्कशक्ति प्रश्न #2)
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q3 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0003]**
- (EN): Pointing to a photograph of a fighter pilot, Amit said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is Amit related to the pilot? (Reasoning Problem #3)
- (HI): एक लड़ाकू विमान पायलट की तस्वीर की ओर इशारा करते हुए अमित ने कहा, 'उनकी मां मेरी मां की इकलौती बेटी है।' अमित का पायलट से क्या संबंध है? (तर्कशक्ति प्रश्न #3)
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

- (HI): एक कैडेट उत्तर की ओर 15 km मार्च करता है, फिर दाएं मुड़कर 8 km मार्च करता है। वह अपने प्रारंभिक पोस्ट से कितनी दूरी और किस दिशा में है? (तर्कशक्ति प्रश्न #4)
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q5 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0005]**
- (EN): Select the related word pair: 'Fighter Jet : Air Force :: Warship : ?' (Reasoning Problem #5)
- (HI): संबंधित शब्द युग्म का चयन करें: 'लड़ाकू जेट : वायु सेना :: युद्धपोत : ?' (तर्कशक्ति प्रश्न #5)
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q6 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0006]**
- (EN): In a row of 45 airmen, Flight Cadet Rohan is ranked 18th from the left end. What is his rank from the right end of the row? (Reasoning Problem #6)
- (HI): 45 वायुसैनिकों की एक पंक्ति में फ्लाइट कैडेट रोहन बाएं छोर से 18वें स्थान पर है। दाएं छोर से उसका स्थान क्या होगा? (तर्कशक्ति प्रश्न #6)
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q7 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0007]**
- (EN): Which of the following Venn diagrams best represents the relationship between: 'Engineers, Pilots, Human Beings'? (Reasoning Problem #7)
- (HI): निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वेन आरेख 'इंजीनियर, पायलट, मानव' के बीच संबंध को सर्वोत्तम रूप से दर्शाता है? (तर्कशक्ति प्रश्न #7)
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q8 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0008]**
- (EN): If '+' means multiplication, '-' means division, 'x' means addition, and '/' means subtraction, evaluate: 16 x 8 - 4 + 2 / 5. (Reasoning Problem #8)
- (HI): यदि '+' का अर्थ गुणा, '-' का अर्थ भाग, 'x' का अर्थ जोड़ और '/' का अर्थ घटाव है, तो मान ज्ञात कीजिए: 16 x 8 - 4 + 2 / 5. (तर्कशक्ति प्रश्न #8)
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q9 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0009]**
- (EN): Find the odd one out from the given group of aircraft: (Reasoning Problem #9)
- (HI): दिए गए विमानों के समूह में से विजातीय (Odd One Out) को चुनिए: (तर्कशक्ति प्रश्न #9)
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q10 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0010]**
- (EN): At what time between 3 o'clock and 4 o'clock will the hands of a clock coincide (be together)? (Reasoning Problem #10)
- (HI): 3 और 4 बजे के बीच किस समय घड़ी की दोनों सुइयां एक साथ (संपाती) होंगी? (तर्कशक्ति प्रश्न #10)
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q11 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0011]**
- (EN): Find the next term in the number series: 7, 14, 28, 56, 112, ____? (Reasoning Problem #11)
- (HI): दी गई संख्या श्रृंखला में अगला पद ज्ञात कीजिए: 7, 14, 28, 56, 112, ____? (तर्कशक्ति प्रश्न #11)
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q12 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0012]**
- (EN): In a certain code language, 'RADAR' is coded as 'TBECT'. How will 'PILOT' be coded in that same language? (Reasoning Problem #12)

- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q13 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0013]**
- (EN): Pointing to a photograph of a fighter pilot, Amit said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is Amit related to the pilot? (Reasoning Problem #13)

- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q14 [iaf-agniveer-raga-reasoning | ID: iaf-vayu-raga-reasoning-0014]**
- (EN): A cadet marches 15 km towards North, turns right and marches 8 km. How far and in which direction is he from his initial starting post? (Reasoning Problem #14)

## 3. Essential Indian Air Force Facts
- **Motto**: 'Nabha Sparsham Deeptam' (Touch the Sky with Glory) from the Bhagavad Gita.
- **Air Force Day**: 8th October (Established 1932).
- **IAF Operational Commands**:
  - Western Air Command: Subroto Park, New Delhi
  - Eastern Air Command: Shillong, Meghalaya
  - Central Air Command: Prayagraj, UP
  - South Western Air Command: Gandhinagar, Gujarat
  - Southern Air Command: Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala
  - Training Command: Bengaluru, Karnataka
  - Maintenance Command: Nagpur, Maharashtra
- **Param Vir Chakra Recipient**: Flying Officer Nirmal Jit Singh Sekhon (1971 war).

## 3. High-Scoring Grammar Principles
- Subject-Verb Agreement: Words like 'Neither... nor', 'Either... or', 'Not only... but also' agree with the nearer subject.
- Conditional sentences: 'Had + V3' in the if-clause requires 'would have + V3' in the main clause.
- Prepositional accuracy: Insist on, Refrain from, Prevent from, Accused of, Senior to.
